fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reported Q3 results that missed expectations for the first time since 2023, but raised its 2026 net interest income (NII) outlook to $10.62 billion and decided to reduce share buybacks to expand technology and AI investments.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fair value relative to the current share price shows 12% upside potential, and projected 2029 operating income of $6.88 billion represents an increase of $520 million from the current $6.36 billion.
fields.summary_ko.2: The high-cost investment structure for long-term earnings growth carries margin pressure risk if credit and capital market conditions deteriorate, and the bank strengthened long-term funding by issuing bonds maturing 2031–2056 with 5.5–6.7% coupons.
